claims.statement: For the fixed favorable set F(T,p), the primary sum equals the degree-dimension difference in the direct sum of relative simplicial chain complexes (Ind(H_v), Ind(R_v)); in rank and homology terms it is b_(k+1)-b_(k-1)+beta_k-beta_(k-1), where k=p-1.
claims.scope: Exact algebraic reduction for each finite ordinary tree and eligible p in the primary contract, using the original selected leaf tags with multiplicity; it does not establish the required nonpositive sign.
claims.reason: Relative-chain basis dimensions are exactly the tagged marked independent-set counts q_v(j), and chain rank-nullity proves the identity. The selector-conditioned inequality b_(k+1)+beta_k<=b_(k-1)+beta_(k-1) remains unproved, and no complete-sum counterexample was found.

limitations: The selector condition has not been converted into a bound on the relative-chain boundary ranks or homology dimensions.
The rank identity is an algebraic reduction only; it proves neither the primary aggregate nor a refutation.
No computation or primary-literature theorem application was used.
